title: Europubhealth+, European Public Health Master
about: Europubhealth+, the European Public Health Master (Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Degree), is open for its 2027 intake. Applicants seeking Erasmus Mundus scholarships must apply by 8 January 2027, with interviews on 18 February 2027; self-funded applications close 24 March 2027.
requirements: University Bachelor degree (180 ECTS) or certified equivalent
Valid proof of language proficiency uploaded before the deadline
Documents issued within 12 months before the application deadline
